triggers.detailsText: Quarterly Overview Management Commentary 4 Bharat Oberoi Chairman and Managing Director “During the quarter, the company reported a revenue of INR 780 crore, registering growth of 26.7% YoY with an EBITDA growth of 20.4% YoY, margin of 13.6% and a PAT growth of 27.3% YoY, margin of 8.3%. On segmental basis, our DG Set business contributed 81.4% of the overall revenue and delivered an EBITDA margin of 5.6 %, Notably, execution for orders in the MSLG business was impacted by temporary logistical challenges in transporting and installing large engine sets, the pending installations are expected to be completed in the subsequent quarters. The Wind Power business contributed 18.6% of revenue with an EBITDA margin of 48.6 %, the improvement in margin is due to seasonality impact and addition 51.3 MW in Feb-26.

On segmental basis, our DG Set business contributed 81.4% of the overall revenue and delivered an EBITDA margin of 5.6 %, Notably, execution for orders in the MSLG business was impacted by temporary logistical challenges in transporting and installing large engine sets, the pending installations are expected to be completed in the subsequent quarters.
The Wind Power business contributed 18.6% of revenue with an EBITDA margin of 48.6 %, the improvement in margin is due to seasonality impact and addition 51.3 MW in Feb-26.
